# Fila Calendar

> Documentation for asmit/fila-calendar — a polished inline calendar field for Filament.

## Documentation Sets

- [Fila Calendar - Full Documentation](https://asmitnepali.github.io/fila-calendar//llms-full.txt): Complete documentation for the Fila Calendar package.

## Getting Started

- [Introduction](https://asmitnepali.github.io/fila-calendar/raw/getting-started/introduction.md): A polished inline calendar field for Filament forms and infolists.
- [Installation](https://asmitnepali.github.io/fila-calendar/raw/getting-started/installation.md): Install the package in a Laravel Filament application.
- [Development](https://asmitnepali.github.io/fila-calendar/raw/getting-started/development.md): Symlink the package locally while developing.
- [Usage](https://asmitnepali.github.io/fila-calendar/raw/getting-started/usage.md): Form fields, infolist entries, and state formats.

## Guide

- [Modes](https://asmitnepali.github.io/fila-calendar/raw/guide/modes.md): Single, multiple, range, and multi-range selection modes.
- [Configuration](https://asmitnepali.github.io/fila-calendar/raw/guide/configuration.md): Calendar layout, bounds, and disabled dates.
- [Localization](https://asmitnepali.github.io/fila-calendar/raw/guide/localization.md): Localize month names, weekdays, and dropdown labels.
